d:
Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif called October 27 a “black day” in Jammu and Kashmir’s history.
His post recalled the arrival of the Indian Air Force in Srinagar on October 27, 1947.
But the post did not mention why Indian forces had to be airlifted to Srinagar in the first place. The move came after tribal forces backed by Pakistan launched an invasion of Jammu and Kashmir in October 1947.
So, what happened on October 27, 1947, and why is Shehbaz Sharif’s version being called an incomplete account of history?
